desc: 彩条翻领短袖童装，晴空蓝几何首屏加空白号型信息层
leaf: 中童彩条翻领短袖POLO衫（两粒扣门襟，配同场短裤外穿）
name: 中童彩条翻领短袖POLO衫款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里先看清是一件彩条翻领短袖而不是圆领T恤，用无身体的立版单品抢点击并满足白底主图合规。
主图一秒法则：把源页那张海报式首屏的结构复用到上传产品上，一次讲完头号利益，同时用颈部以下裁切规避童模面容。
shots.textZone: one headline slot and one subline slot on the paper window at the upper left, one blank indicator rail beneath them

shots.intent: 把源页柔软不起球的口号翻回痛点：先给出汗后衣身贴背与洗后起毛两个真实状态，再在右屏交出版型与织面解法。
shots.textZone: one short label slot centred under each panel

shots.intent: 承接源页设计师说那一屏：用斜切几何面板与两栏版面把设计理念讲成一屏卖点，文字全部留空给卖家填。
shots.textZone: headline slot and four blank body rules in the left copy column, one label slot under the image card

shots.intent: 用最贵的结构证据替掉口号：领座、两粒扣门襟与条纹在肩缝处的断色一次看清，证明翻领工艺而不是喊柔软。
shots.textZone: one caption slot at the lower right

shots.intent: 复现源页的机制解释屏：一枚大空窗加三枚线描圆章把结构讲成可核对的视觉证据，指标词面一律留空。
shots.textZone: one blank caption slot beneath each of the three ring medallions

shots.intent: 替家长回答买大买小：照搬源页的参数行加三档指数条加多列尺码表结构，但每一格都留空由卖家真实数据填。
shots.textZone: four blank parameter rows, three blank indicator bars with four unlabelled ticks and one fully empty banded table grid

shots.intent: 把源页的四宫格配色屏复现成可替换结构：四只圆角硬边空窗加四个空白色名位，色档一律由参考图决定。
shots.textZone: one short blank colour-label slot centred under each frame

shots.intent: 自我代入：用三格上身拼贴一次给全正面气势、膝下走动与侧缝垂坠，面容与身份一律不入镜。
shots.textZone: one narrow vertical word rail outside the frames holding blank letter slots only

shots.intent: 降风险但不喊保证：用可核对的折叠做工与一枚全空吊牌收信任，把源页的服务承诺屏换成实物证据。
shots.textZone: one headline slot above the tag and four blank caption slots under the care ring medallions, every credential field left blank

shots.intent: 收口只给动作位：把源页的会员角标与二维码换成一条黄通栏加一枚描边空按钮，不带任何价格与优惠事实。
shots.textZone: one outlined rectangular button slot on the ribbon band plus one headline slot in the paper window

style.backgroundSystem: die-cut paper window #F3F9FC with hard-cut corners set on a saturated azure seamless studio paper sweep #35B4E5 for every worn screen, flat paper field #F3F9FC for packshot, split-screen and grid screens, one palest azure step #EAF4F9 sanctioned only as a tinted band, ink-blue matte field #16232F reserved for the collar macro and the closing screen; one background idea per screen, never a gradient, never scenery, never a furnished interior, never a hue outside this list
style.direction: bright poster-block children's summer knitwear commerce, die-cut paper windows on a saturated azure studio field held by one lemon-yellow ribbon discipline
style.iconSystem: abstract thin-line pictographs drawn inside solid ring medallions in ink-blue #16232F, plus two solid lemon-yellow #FFD53E ring discs with a punched centre as the only decorative shapes and one short lemon-yellow zigzag ribbon strip; no shields, no crests, no hexagon cells, no diamond cells, no square index chips, no corner wedges, no checkmark seals, no certificate plates and no QR artwork
style.lightingSystem: cool high-key studio light at 6200K entering from the upper left, large softbox key with a bounce fill on the shadow side, one honest directional shadow lying to the right, a true contact shadow under every hem and both shoe soles, grazing low light only inside the collar macro, no warm cast, no rim flash, no blown specular hotspot
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright poster-block children's summer knitwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud-paper white #F3F9FC, saturated azure studio field #35B4E5, soda-lemon yellow #FFD53E and ink-blue black #16232F, with one product-matched accent supplied at generation time as {accent_color}; cool high-key studio light at 6200K from the upper left with a large bounce fill, one honest directional shadow to the right and a true contact shadow under every hem and both soles; background system of a die-cut paper window #F3F9FC on the azure seamless sweep #35B4E5 for worn screens, a flat paper field #F3F9FC for packshot, split and grid screens, one palest azure step #EAF4F9 used only as a tinted band and an ink-blue matte field #16232F for the collar macro and the closing screen, never a gradient and never scenery; one modern geometric sans-serif, copy carried only as corner-bracketed selling-point and callout placeholders with one headline slot and one subline slot per screen, no pinyin display line and no oversized outline display word; layout grammar limited to a hard-cut die-cut paper window, one full-width lemon-yellow #FFD53E ribbon band, solid ring discs with a punched centre, one short zigzag ribbon strip, two tilted parallelogram panels, banded table rows with every cell left blank, one blank segmented indicator bar with four unlabelled ticks, solid ring medallion pictographs and one outlined rectangular button slot, with no shield, no crest, no hexagon or diamond cell, no corner wedge, no checkmark seal, no certificate plate and no QR artwork; the collared knit top holds one stable scale, every worn frame a generic child body cropped from the neck down, from the knee down or below the shoulders so no identifiable face appears, and the stripe rhythm, folded neckband and two-button placket named structurally and never redrawn; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new hue outside #F3F9FC, #35B4E5, #FFD53E and #16232F plus the single sanctioned palest azure step #EAF4F9
no mixed fonts, no brush lettering, no script, no serif and no oversized outline display word
no random backgrounds, no furnished interior, no street scene and no gradient sweep
no inconsistent lighting direction and no missing contact shadow under any hem or sole
no mismatched icon styles and no shield, crest, hexagon, diamond or square icon plate
no identifiable child face, no teen or adult proportions and no invented body shape on the garment
no redrawn garment stripes, no legible characters, numerals or years inside any graphic zone
no price, coupon, discount, membership, service-promise or shop wording in any screen
style.presentationRules: the collared knit top stays the hero at one scale across the set, never shifting more than five percent between screens, its paired bottom appearing only as a styling layer; every worn frame is a generic child body cropped from the neck down, from the knee down or below the shoulders, never an identifiable face; the horizontal stripe rhythm, the folded neckband and the two-button placket are named structurally, kept square-on and never redrawn; the chest graphic zone, if the reference carries one, stays a blank rectangular slot
style.surfaceSystem: matte paper card #F3F9FC used as the print plane of every layout block, saturated azure seamless studio paper #35B4E5 as the worn backdrop and floor, ink-blue matte board #16232F under the macro crop and behind the closing window; garment faces stay flat, unwrinkled and lint-free, no dust, no floor debris, no real furniture and no second wall colour
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for every Chinese and Latin label; in-image copy only ever carried as selling-point and callout placeholders inside corner brackets, one headline slot and one subline slot per screen; headline 26-40pt, subline 14-16pt, label 12-13pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters; no brush lettering, no oversized outline display word, no script, no serif, no pinyin display line, no rendered numerals and no filled-in Latin filler paragraph
